How much do your services cost?

Our rates vary based on the type and duration of services needed. We offer competitive hourly rates and package deals for regular care. Most services are covered by private insurance or government programs. Contact us for a personalized quote.
How do you screen your companions?
All our companions undergo thorough background checks, reference verification, skills assessment, and ongoing training. They are bonded, insured, and certified in first aid and CPR.
What happens in case of an emergency?

Our companions are trained to handle emergencies and have direct access to our 24/7 support line. We maintain emergency contacts and medical information for all clients and coordinate with healthcare providers when needed.
In non-emergency situations, we can typically start services within 48-72 hours after the initial consultation. For urgent needs, we offer same-day placement when available.
